This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their elongated craniums and horizontal cavities on both sides of their necks.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[3 BBY]], a member of this species was staying on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]],<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref> while another attended a party hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]] on the planet [[Coruscant]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> A year later, a member of this species was present near the [[Imperial Senate Building]], witnessing [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> Much later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> another member of this species was present at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in [[Canto Bight]] on [[Cantonica]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Ovoid-Headed-Species-Concept-Art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Luke Fisher and Robert Rowley]]
This species first appeared in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> This species was designed by concept artist [[Luke Fisher]], with [[Robert Rowley]] designing their outfit.<ref name="Luke Fisher">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
